is_mandatory.quote: Any person who owns or possesses any bees, hives, colonies or beekeeping equipment in this state or who owns or possesses an apiary in this state and who fails or refuses to register that apiary as provided in this chapter is guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Owning or possessing bees, hives, colonies or beekeeping equipment without registering the apiary as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who owns or possesses any bees, hives, colonies or beekeeping equipment in this state or who owns or possesses an apiary in this state and who fails or refuses to register that apiary as provided in this chapter is guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: A beekeeper who refuses inspection on any of the seven agreed-upon inspection dates is subject to penalties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any beekeeper responsible for an apiary who refuses an inspection on any of the seven (7) agreed upon dates is subject to penalties provided pursuant to W.S. 11-7-133

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with a rule, order, or provision of a quarantine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person failing to comply with a rule, order or provision of a quarantine pursuant to this section is subject to penalties provided in W.S. 11-7-133.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the apiary chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who violates any provision of this chapter is guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction shall be fined not more than five hundred dollars ($500.00) or imprisoned in the county jail for not more than six (6) months, or both.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Importing bees with honey used as food in transit, or using honey for queen cage foods when shipping queen bees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for anyone shipping queen bees in cages into this state to use any honey for queen cage foods.

definition_quote.value: "Apiary" means a place where one (1) or more colonies of bees or one (1) or more hives containing honeycombs or bee combs are kept
definition_quote.quote: "Apiary" means a place where one (1) or more colonies of bees or one (1) or more hives containing honeycombs or bee combs are kept

registration_required.quote: Any person who owns or possesses any class of apiary in this state shall register that apiary with the department before April 1 of each year.

apiary_identification_required.quote: Each apiary registrant shall post in a conspicuous location at or near each apiary he owns legible evidence of registration, including his name and telephone number.

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: The total number of colonies of bees the beekeeper owns

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: The location of the apiary, setting forth specifically the location by sectional division to the nearest quarter section, the township and range and the latitude and longitude coordinates

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: An apiary not regularly attended in accordance with good beekeeping practice, which comprises a hazard or threat to disease control in the beekeeping industry or which by reason of its physical condition or construction cannot be inspected, may be considered an abandoned apiary and may be seized by the department.

import_permit_required.quote: A beekeeper shall notify the department and request an inspection to be conducted at any specified registered location or holding yard not later than fourteen (14) days after entry of any colony into this state.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: All package bees shipped into Wyoming shall be accompanied by an affidavit stating that no honey has been used for food in transit.

combless_package_import_exemption.quote: Bees shipped on combless packages or in packages on new frames and new foundation are not prohibited.

regulated_diseases.quote: "Bee diseases" means American or European foulbrood, sacbrood, bee paralysis or other disease or abnormal condition of the egg, larval, pupal or adult stages of bees, including bee parasites and bee pests

disease_reporting_required.quote: Quarantine any apiary where foulbrood or any contagious or infectious bee diseases, bee parasites or bee pests are present and, during the quarantine, prevent the removal from the apiary of any bees or equipment except under a special permit issued by the department

quarantine_authority.quote: Quarantine any apiary where foulbrood or any contagious or infectious bee diseases, bee parasites or bee pests are present and, during the quarantine, prevent the removal from the apiary of any bees or equipment except under a special permit issued by the department

right_of_entry_scope.quote: Inspect any apiary, hives, equipment or premises for the presence of bee diseases, bee parasites or bee pests. Hives belonging to persons owning apiaries within the state shall be inspected for contagious diseases according to schedules established by the department.

queen_rearing_apiary_certification_requi.quote: "Queen apiary" means an apiary or premises in which queen bees are reared or kept for sale or gift

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: A person may not sell or offer for sale any apiary, bees or equipment which are under quarantine unless the department issues a permit authorizing the sale or removal.

apiary_minimum_distance_rule.quote: general apiaries registered to different persons shall be located at least two (2) miles apart
